title: Chapter 341 Upgrading Wana County
content:
Chapter 341 Upgrading Wana County

"I don't know about that. Some people died directly in it, some people could not get out of it for their whole life, and some people got out of it in three to five months."

The opportunity was right in front of him, Wang Shuo gritted his teeth and went!

After a little thought, Wang Shuo gave Zhao Bangde the "Outline of the Shenwu Empire".

And told his guess.

Zhao Bangde showed a solemn look.

"So we are on the edge of the Shenwu Empire!" He frowned.

"It just so happens that Shura Tower is also a place that students from various colleges in the Shenwu Empire like to challenge the most. At that time, you can just meet countless geniuses of the Shenwu Empire."

Before leaving, Zhao Bangde handed Wang Shuo a county-level town heart, as well as various materials for upgrading the county.

"Don't worry, before you come back, as long as I am still here, your Wana Town will be safe and sound."

The two chatted for a while, and Wang Shuo said goodbye to Zhao Bangde and left Shanhai City.

Wana Town.

After Wang Shuo returned to the territory, he immediately checked the conditions for upgrading the county.

A third-level town is needed.

Wang Shuo had long asked Duan Wenxi to continuously transfer the population of Changping County to Wana Town, and now there are more than 100,000 people.

All the conditions for upgrading are already in place, and Wang Shuo directly chose to upgrade.

[Wana Town is upgraded to a second-level town. ]

[Wana Town is upgraded to a third-level town. ]

[Wana Town is upgraded to a county town. ]

[System announcement: Wang Shuo, the lord of Wana Town, has upgraded his territory to a county town. This is hereby announced. ]

The system announcement finally appeared for upgrading the county town.

Countless fans of Wang Shuo were very excited.

At this time, Wang Shuo still had a very high reputation in Changping County.

[Since you are the first player to upgrade the county town, you will be rewarded with +2000 Wana County reputation and territory attribute: martial spirit. ]

[Martial spirit: The upgrade experience of the territory's people is reduced by 10%, and the speed of practicing martial arts is increased by 10%. ]

Wang Shuo checked the territory attributes.

[Territory attributes]

[Territory: Wana County (primary county)]

[Lord: Wang Shuo]

[Territory attributes: popular support, outstanding people, martial spirit]

[Territory reputation: 3000 (famous far and wide)]

[Area: 20 kilometers in radius]

[Population: 120,000]

[Popularity: 86 (average)]

[Buildings: ...]

[Military: ...]

[Auspicious beast in the territory: Koi (juvenile)]

...

[Upgrade conditions: Upgrade to a second-level county requires a population of 150,000, popular support of 85, and a gold energy converter. Buildings: Lord's Mansion, residential buildings, teleportation array, ...]

Wang Shuo called all the high-level officials of Wana County to the meeting hall of the Lord's Mansion.

He held a regular meeting.

After inquiring about the situation of each department, deciding on some major policies, and handling government affairs, Wang Shuo announced that the territory would hold a banquet in the evening to let everyone relax.

Then some core personnel of the territory stayed behind.

"Next, I have an important announcement to make." Wang Shuo said seriously.

Chang Gui stood up and turned his wooden head.

"My Lord, I have specially divined for you today."

Wang Shuo was uneasy.

Although he did not believe in these things, he was still a little upset when someone predicted his fate.

"What is it about?"

"Travel far away!"

When Chang Gui said these two words, Wang Shuo suddenly felt nervous.

Chang Gui was about to say it.

Wang Shuo stopped him.

"No need to say it!"

"Life is interesting because the future is unknown, isn't it?"

Wang Shuo was also afraid that once he knew the result, it would affect his Tao heart.

It's better not to know!
